Bash(npx @reserve-protocol/dtf-cli discover --chain all --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import sys,json
data=json.load\(sys.stdin\)
targets = ['hyusd','bsdx','vaya','rgusd','knox','usdc+','dgneth','maat']
for d in data.get\('dtfs',[]\):
    sym = d.get\('symbol',''\).lower\(\)
    if sym in targets:
        print\(json.dumps\({'symbol': d.get\('symbol'\), 'address': d.get\('address'\), 'chain': d.get\('chain'\), 'name': d.get\('name'\)}\)\)
")

import sys,json

        print\(json.dumps\(d, indent=2\)\)
print\(f'Total DTFs: {len\(data.get\(\\"dtfs\\",[]\)\)}'\)
# Print all symbols
